summary: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, announcing the appointment of Allen C. Harper as Interim CEO and Principal Executive Officer for a 180-day term, effective immediately. Harper, a former board member, replaces the prior CEO in what appears to be an abrupt transition, though the board states no change in strategic direction or day-to-day operations. No terms, price, or premium are disclosed. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 outlines the appointment. The board expresses confidence in Harper's leadership. Watch for any further management shifts or strategic updates that may follow this sudden leadership change.
